items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: Morris had the trio in the bar.

ctx.x: Right. Because I had the group at Small's downstairs. Herman had a group upstairs, and Morris had the trio in the bar. And Charlie used to come down there, called me and said, Hap, you coming over to Monroe? I said, sure, I'll go to Monroe. We called him Money

for short. And we'd -- we'd finish our club date at Small's. We'd all go over to Monroe's at 134th and 7th Avenue, just like about walking across the street. And, see, that was Borah (unintelligible) Wilkins. That why it was (unintelligible) named Club Band, but it was Borah Wilkins Club. Then after he got killed -- that was in the early -- late '20's -- then --
